description: This file defines the 'PerformanceTracker' entity class within an ORM framework, representing a performance tracking record with properties such as name, dates, status, and references to employee entities and reviewers. It includes ORM mappings, constructors, and getter/setter methods.

classes.name: PerformanceTracker
classes.description: Entity class representing a performance tracker record for an employee, with ORM mappings, properties, and methods to access and modify its data.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the performance tracker.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier for the performance tracker.

methods.name: getTrackerName
methods.description: Returns the name of the performance tracker.

methods.name: setTrackerName
methods.description: Sets the name of the performance tracker.

methods.name: getAddedDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the performance tracker was added.

methods.name: setAddedDate
methods.description: Sets the date when the performance tracker was added.

methods.name: getModifiedDate
methods.description: Returns the date when the performance tracker was last modified, or null.

methods.name: setModifiedDate
methods.description: Sets the date when the performance tracker was last modified.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the status of the tracker, e.g., deleted or not.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status of the tracker.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the Employee entity associated with this tracker.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Associates an Employee with this tracker.

methods.name: getAddedBy
methods.description: Returns the Employee who added the tracker.

methods.name: setAddedBy
methods.description: Sets the Employee who added the tracker.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerReviewer
methods.description: Returns the collection of reviewers associated with this tracker.

methods.name: setPerformanceTrackerReviewer
methods.description: Sets or updates the collection of reviewers for this tracker.
